esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_*_lookup, -serverless_chargeback_conf_lookup*, logs-chargeback_serverless.lookup-*, metrics-chargeback_serverless.billing-*, metrics-ess_billing.credits-*, -metrics-ess_billing.credits-chargeback*, metrics-chargeback_serverless.usage-* METADATA _index
| EVAL threshold_stale_hours = 36.0, ing_ts = TO_DATETIME(event.ingested), doc_ts = TO_DATETIME(@timestamp)
| EVAL is_lookup = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_"),
       is_bc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_cost_lookup"),
       is_rp = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup"),
       is_pc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_project_contribution_lookup"),
       is_dc = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup"),
       is_dc_src = (NOT STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_")) AND CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-chargeback_serverless.usage-") AND COALESCE(doc_type, "") == "datastream",
       is_ps = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_project_status_lookup"),
       is_ai = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup"),
       is_sy = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup"),
       is_cr = STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_billing_credits_lookup"),
       is_ps_src = (NOT STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_")) AND CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-chargeback_serverless.usage-") AND COALESCE(doc_type, "") == "project_status",
       is_ai_src = (NOT STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_")) AND CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-chargeback_serverless.usage-") AND COALESCE(doc_type, "") == "ai_model",
       is_sy_src = (NOT STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_")) AND CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-chargeback_serverless.usage-") AND COALESCE(doc_type, "") == "synthetics_monitor",
       is_cr_src = (NOT STARTS_WITH(_index, "serverless_")) AND ((CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-chargeback_serverless.billing-") AND COALESCE(doc_type, "") == "credit_line_item") OR (CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-ess_billing.credits-") AND NOT CONTAINS(_index, "metrics-ess_billing.credits-chargeback")))
| STATS
    lookup_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_lookup, 1, null)),
    bc_last = MAX(CASE(is_bc, ing_ts, null)), bc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_bc, doc_ts, null)), bc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_bc, 1, null)),
    rp_last = MAX(CASE(is_rp, ing_ts, null)), rp_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_rp, doc_ts, null)), rp_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_rp, 1, null)),
    pc_last = MAX(CASE(is_pc, ing_ts, null)), pc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_pc, doc_ts, null)), pc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_pc, 1, null)),
    dc_last = MAX(CASE(is_dc, ing_ts, null)), dc_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_dc, doc_ts, null)), dc_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_dc, 1, null)),
    dc_src_last = MAX(CASE(is_dc_src, COALESCE(ing_ts, doc_ts), null)),
    ps_last = MAX(CASE(is_ps, ing_ts, null)), ps_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_ps, doc_ts, null)), ps_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_ps, 1, null)),
    ps_src_last = MAX(CASE(is_ps_src, COALESCE(ing_ts, doc_ts), null)),
    ai_last = MAX(CASE(is_ai, ing_ts, null)), ai_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_ai, doc_ts, null)), ai_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_ai, 1, null)),
    ai_src_last = MAX(CASE(is_ai_src, COALESCE(ing_ts, doc_ts), null)),
    sy_last = MAX(CASE(is_sy, ing_ts, null)), sy_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_sy, doc_ts, null)), sy_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_sy, 1, null)),
    sy_src_last = MAX(CASE(is_sy_src, COALESCE(ing_ts, doc_ts), null)),
    cr_last = MAX(CASE(is_cr, ing_ts, null)), cr_doc_ts = MAX(CASE(is_cr, doc_ts, null)), cr_cnt = COUNT(CASE(is_cr, 1, null)),
    cr_src_last = MAX(CASE(is_cr_src, COALESCE(ing_ts, doc_ts), null)),
    threshold_stale_hours = COALESCE(MAX(threshold_stale_hours), 36.0)
| EVAL all_sources_missing = (lookup_cnt == 0)
| EVAL bc_age = CASE(bc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", bc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       rp_age = CASE(rp_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", rp_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       pc_age = CASE(pc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", pc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       dc_age = CASE(dc_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       dc_src_age = CASE(dc_src_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_src_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       dc_src_lag_min = CASE(dc_src_last IS NOT NULL AND dc_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_last, dc_src_last), null),
       dc_src_wait_min = CASE(dc_src_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_src_last, NOW()), null),
       pc_src_lag_min = CASE(dc_last IS NOT NULL AND pc_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", pc_last, dc_last), null),
       pc_src_wait_min = CASE(dc_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", dc_last, NOW()), null),
       ps_age = CASE(ps_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ps_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ps_src_age = CASE(ps_src_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ps_src_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ps_src_lag_min = CASE(ps_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ps_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", ps_last, ps_src_last), null),
       ps_src_wait_min = CASE(ps_src_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", ps_src_last, NOW()), null),
       ai_age = CASE(ai_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ai_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ai_src_age = CASE(ai_src_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", ai_src_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       ai_src_lag_min = CASE(ai_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ai_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", ai_last, ai_src_last), null),
       ai_src_wait_min = CASE(ai_src_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", ai_src_last, NOW()), null),
       sy_age = CASE(sy_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", sy_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       sy_src_age = CASE(sy_src_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", sy_src_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       sy_src_lag_min = CASE(sy_src_last IS NOT NULL AND sy_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", sy_last, sy_src_last), null),
       sy_src_wait_min = CASE(sy_src_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", sy_src_last, NOW()), null),
       cr_age = CASE(cr_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", cr_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       cr_src_age = CASE(cr_src_last IS NOT NULL, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(DATE_DIFF("minute", cr_src_last, NOW())) / 60.0, 1), null),
       cr_src_lag_min = CASE(cr_src_last IS NOT NULL AND cr_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", cr_last, cr_src_last), null),
       cr_src_wait_min = CASE(cr_src_last IS NOT NULL, DATE_DIFF("minute", cr_src_last, NOW()), null)
| EVAL dc_stale = dc_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ((dc_src_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((dc_cnt > 0 AND (dc_last IS NULL OR dc_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (dc_cnt == 0 AND dc_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (dc_src_wait_min > 30 AND (dc_cnt == 0 OR dc_last IS NULL OR (dc_age > threshold_stale_hours AND dc_src_lag_min > 30)))),
       pc_stale = dc_last IS NOT NULL AND ((dc_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((pc_cnt > 0 AND (pc_last IS NULL OR pc_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (pc_cnt == 0 AND pc_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (pc_src_wait_min > 30 AND (pc_cnt == 0 OR pc_last IS NULL OR (pc_age > threshold_stale_hours AND pc_src_lag_min > 30)))),
       ps_stale = ps_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ((ps_src_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((ps_cnt > 0 AND (ps_last IS NULL OR ps_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (ps_cnt == 0 AND ps_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (ps_src_wait_min > 30 AND (ps_cnt == 0 OR ps_last IS NULL OR (ps_age > threshold_stale_hours AND ps_src_lag_min > 30)))),
       ai_stale = ai_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ((ai_src_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((ai_cnt > 0 AND (ai_last IS NULL OR ai_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (ai_cnt == 0 AND ai_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (ai_src_wait_min > 30 AND (ai_cnt == 0 OR ai_last IS NULL OR (ai_age > threshold_stale_hours AND ai_src_lag_min > 30)))),
       sy_stale = sy_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ((sy_src_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((sy_cnt > 0 AND (sy_last IS NULL OR sy_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (sy_cnt == 0 AND sy_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (sy_src_wait_min > 30 AND (sy_cnt == 0 OR sy_last IS NULL OR (sy_age > threshold_stale_hours AND sy_src_lag_min > 30)))),
       cr_stale = cr_src_last IS NOT NULL AND ((cr_src_age <= threshold_stale_hours AND ((cr_cnt > 0 AND (cr_last IS NULL OR cr_age > threshold_stale_hours)) OR (cr_cnt == 0 AND cr_src_wait_min > 30))) OR (cr_src_wait_min > 30 AND (cr_cnt == 0 OR cr_last IS NULL OR (cr_age > threshold_stale_hours AND cr_src_lag_min > 30))))
| EVAL e_bc = CASE(all_sources_missing OR bc_cnt == 0 OR bc_last IS NULL OR bc_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_billing_cost_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(bc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_cost_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(bc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(bc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_rp = CASE(all_sources_missing OR rp_cnt == 0 OR rp_last IS NULL OR rp_age > threshold_stale_hours, CONCAT("serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(rp_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_realized_pool_lookup` transform output is missing or stale (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(rp_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(rp_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_pc = CASE(pc_stale, CONCAT("serverless_project_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(pc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_project_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(pc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(pc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_dc = CASE(dc_stale, CONCAT("serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(dc_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_datastream_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_src_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(dc_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(dc_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_ps = CASE(ps_stale, CONCAT("serverless_project_status_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(ps_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_project_status_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_src_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ps_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(ps_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_ai = CASE(ai_stale, CONCAT("serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(ai_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_ai_model_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_src_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(ai_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(ai_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_sy = CASE(sy_stale, CONCAT("serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(sy_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_synthetics_monitor_contribution_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_src_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(sy_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(sy_cnt), ")."), null),
       e_cr = CASE(cr_stale, CONCAT("serverless_billing_credits_lookup\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_last), "never"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_doc_ts), "none"), "\t", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_age), "n/a"), "\t", TO_STRING(cr_cnt), "\tLookup index `serverless_billing_credits_lookup` transform output is missing or stale relative to latest credit source event ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_src_last), "none"), " (last ingested ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_last), "never"), ", ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(cr_age), "n/a"), "h ago; threshold=", TO_STRING(threshold_stale_hours), "h, docs=", TO_STRING(cr_cnt), ")."), null)
| EVAL _raw = CONCAT(CASE(e_bc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_bc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_rp IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_rp, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_pc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_pc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_dc IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_dc, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_ps IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_ps, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_ai IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_ai, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_sy IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_sy, "\n"), ""), CASE(e_cr IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(e_cr, "\n"), ""))
| WHERE _raw != ""
| EVAL entries = SPLIT(_raw, "\n")
| MV_EXPAND entries
| WHERE entries != ""
| DISSECT entries "%{idx_group}\t%{last_ingested}\t%{last_doc_ts}\t%{age_hours}\t%{doc_count_str}\t%{result}"
| EVAL doc_count = TO_INTEGER(doc_count_str)
| STATS result = MAX(result), last_ingested = MAX(last_ingested), last_doc_ts = MAX(last_doc_ts), age_hours = MAX(age_hours), doc_count = MAX(doc_count), threshold_stale_hours = MAX(threshold_stale_hours) BY idx_group
| SORT idx_group ASC
| KEEP result, idx_group, last_ingested, last_doc_ts, age_hours, doc_count, threshold_stale_hours
